description: Head-movement mini-game GA08: nod-catch timing game, voice-guided. Ten balls fall one at a time over a fixed 3 seconds past a visible center catch line; a gentle nod while the ball is within 15 percent of screen height around the line catches it. One nod per ball, no second chance; early or late nods miss that ball. No circling, no jerking, no camera, no mic/ASR.
name: nod-catch
